title: Serendipity in recommender systems: a systematic review of definitions, methods, evaluation, and ethics in the era of generative AI
title_zh: 生成式人工智能时代推荐系统中的偶然性：定义、方法、评估与伦理的系统综述
abstract: Abstract Serendipity, the discovery of unexpected yet valuable items, has become an important objective for recommender systems (RS) aiming to reduce filter bubbles and support long-term user satisfaction. Although accuracy-driven models predict known preferences effectively, they can restrict exploration and reinforce narrow consumption patterns. Despite increasing attention to serendipity as a beyond-accuracy objective, the field remains fragmented because definitions, evaluation protocols, and ethical considerations are not consistently aligned. This systematic review examines serendipity in RS from 2020 to 2025, covering 147 studies and 98 algorithmic contributions. We synthesize diverse definitions into a unified conceptual framework centred on relevance, novelty, and unexpectedness. We also present a methodological taxonomy that traces the field’s evolution from heuristic and traditional approaches to deep learning, knowledge graph, generative, and LLM-based methods. Reported results show that recent LLM-based approaches can achieve strong performance on serendipity-oriented tasks, with $$\:NDC{G}_{seren}$$ scores of up to 0.398. We further review evaluation practices and highlight the gap between computational proxies and subjective user experience. Through quantitative ethical analysis, we show that 74.1% of studies acknowledge ethical concerns, but only 6.8% include dedicated ethics sections, 19.7% operationalize ethical metrics, and 5.4% address content safety. By integrating conceptual, methodological, evaluative, and ethical perspectives, this review provides guidance for developing serendipity-oriented RS that balance relevance with beneficial discovery.
abstract_zh: 摘要 偶然性，即发现意外而有价值的项目，已成为推荐系统（RS）旨在降低过滤气泡并支持长期用户满意度的重要目标。尽管以准确性为驱动的模型能够有效预测已知偏好，但它们可能限制探索并强化狭窄的消费模式。尽管将偶然性作为超越准确性的目标日益受到关注，但由于定义、评估协议和伦理考量未能保持一致，该领域仍然分散。本系统综述考察了2020年至2025年期间推荐系统中的偶然性，涵盖147项研究和98项算法贡献。我们将多样的定义综合为以相关性、新颖性和意外性为中心的统一概念框架。我们还提出了一种方法学分类法，追溯了该领域从启发式和传统方法到深度学习、知识图谱、生成式及基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法的演变。报告的结果表明，近期的基于LLM的方法在偶然性导向任务上可实现强劲性能，$$\:NDC{G}_{seren}$$分数最高可达0.398。我们还回顾了评估实践，并突出了计算代理与主观用户体验之间的差距。通过定量伦理分析，我们表明，74.1%的研究承认伦理问题，但只有6.8%包含专门的伦理部分，19.7%将伦理指标可操作化，5.4%涉及内容安全。通过整合概念、方法学、评估和伦理视角，本综述为开发在相关性与有益发现之间取得平衡的偶然性导向推荐系统提供了指导。
